results.description:
## What You Can Work Out With This Pay Calculator
Take-home pay is what remains of a wage or salary after PAYG income tax, the Medicare Levy, and any HECS/HELP repayment come out — superannuation is paid on top rather than deducted. This pay calculator turns an annual, monthly, fortnightly, weekly, daily, or hourly figure into net pay after tax for any selected financial year, and models the pieces most tools skip: the Low Income Tax Offset, salary packaging, novated leases, Division 293, and the Medicare Levy Surcharge.
